capabilities: Create and open daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes by clicking dates, week numbers, months, quarters or years in a calendar
Customize periodic-note names, folders and template variables using date-fns date formatting and date arithmetic
Run commands to open periodic notes and navigate the calendar to the next or previous week or month
List all notes created on a selected date, based on file creation date or a frontmatter property
Highlight and locate the currently open note's date in the calendar
extras: The latter half of the README is developer documentation (build, testing, branching strategy, release process); template files must exist for created notes; a roadmap is referenced for contributors.
motivation: The author started the project as a hobby because an existing calendar plugin couldn't handle his custom daily-note date format.
problem: Daily-notes navigation is limited to fixed name formats and no calendar view, so users with custom note-name formats (like yyyyMMdd - eeee) cannot click through their periodic notes.

relations.evidence: The path is also customizable using the date formatting rules of date-fns.

summary: Calendar sidebar for creating and navigating daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes with fully customizable date formats.
